$$\text{Net rate} = \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{6} - \frac{1}{12}$$

$$\text{Net rate} = \frac{3}{12} + \frac{2}{12} - \frac{1}{12} = \frac{3 + 2 - 1}{12} = \frac{4}{12} = \frac{1}{3}$$

The net rate is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the tank per hour. Therefore, the total time required to fill the empty tank is the reciprocal of the net rate:
$$\text{Time} = \frac{1}{\frac{1}{3}} = 3\text{ hours}$$
